title: Capital Town Residences
summary: Premium single-attached homes inside a master-planned business district, minutes from SM Telabastagan and the Provincial Capitol.
description: Capital Town Residences sits at the heart of Pampanga's fastest-growing central business district, offering a rare mix of city convenience and gated-community security.
Each unit is turned over with a spacious living and dining area, a functional kitchen, and a landscaped front yard suited for a growing family.
The development is walking distance to the CSFP Government Center, the SONA public market, and a growing strip of restaurants and offices.
features: Near SM City Telabastagan and Robinsons Starmills

title: Azure North Tower
summary: Resort-style condo living with pool decks, retail strips, and easy access to the North Luzon Expressway.
description: Azure North Tower brings SMDC's resort-inspired condo concept to Pampanga, with wide pool decks, function areas, and ground floor retail.
Units range from studio to two-bedroom layouts, ideal for young professionals, small families, or investors eyeing rental income near business districts.
The tower is a short drive to the San Fernando exit of NLEX and to Clark, making it convenient for commuters and frequent travelers.
features: Resort-style pool deck and lounge areas
Retail arcade at the ground floor
5 minutes from NLEX San Fernando exit

title: Alviera Country Club Estates
summary: Elevated lots with mountain views inside a 1,125-hectare master-planned estate at the foot of the Zambales mountain range.
description: Alviera Country Club Estates offers spacious lot cuts with clear mountain views, part of the larger Alviera mixed-use estate development.
Residents enjoy access to the Alviera Golf Club, Outlets at Alviera, and a growing industrial and commercial hub nearby.
This is suited for end-users wanting a quieter, elevated address, as well as investors banking on Porac's continued growth.
features: Access to Alviera Golf and Country Club
Near Outlets at Alviera and Alviera Industrial Park

title: Rockwell at Nepo Residences
summary: Rockwell's first development outside Metro Manila, bringing luxury condo living to the heart of Angeles City.
description: Rockwell at Nepo Residences is set within a redeveloped Nepo Center, combining retail, dining, and residential towers in one integrated estate.
Units are finished to Rockwell's signature quality standards, appealing to buyers who want a premium address near Clark and Angeles' commercial core.
The estate is envisioned to include a mall, office towers, and a central park, positioning it as a long-term investment in Angeles City.
features: Close to Clark Freeport and Angeles CBD
Function rooms, pool, and fitness center

title: Monterey Heights
summary: Affordable single-detached and duplex homes close to Clark Freeport Zone and Mabalacat's growing commercial strip.
description: Monterey Heights offers value-priced house and lot packages suited for first-time homebuyers and OFW families.
The community is a short drive from the Clark Freeport Zone, SM Telabastagan, and the Mabalacat exit of NLEX and SCTEX.
Model units include single-attached, duplex, and single-detached options across multiple lot cuts.
features: Near Clark Freeport Zone and SCTEX

title: The Orchards Magalang
summary: A quiet farm-to-suburb community in Magalang, ideal for buyers who want space and fresh air within reach of the city.
description: The Orchards Magalang is designed around wide open spaces, tree-lined streets, and a laid-back provincial lifestyle.
It's a practical choice for families who work in San Fernando or Angeles but prefer a quieter home base, roughly 30 minutes away.
Lot-only and house and lot packages are both available, with several model unit options.
features: Lot-only and house and lot options
30 minutes from San Fernando and Angeles

title: Riverpark Place
summary: Low-rise, mid-cost condo living along the riverside, a practical entry point for first-time investors in Pampanga.
description: Riverpark Place offers a mid-rise condo option for buyers who want to own property in Pampanga without a house and lot's maintenance requirements.
The location in Mexico provides easy access to San Fernando's business district while remaining close to more affordable land values.
Studio and one-bedroom cuts are available, popular with young professionals and rental-income investors.
features: Close to San Fernando business district

title: Garden of Life Memorial Estate
summary: Memorial lots set in a landscaped garden estate, offered on flexible installment terms for family lot planning.
description: Garden of Life Memorial Estate offers bronze, silver, and garden lot categories within a well-maintained, landscaped memorial park.
Flexible payment terms make it accessible for families planning ahead, with options for single and family-sized lots.
The estate includes a chapel, function hall, and dedicated caretaking staff.
features: Bronze, silver, and garden lot categories
